Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 8, 2022

On Jun 7, 2022, CB independent-site marketing SaaS QuickCEP (Beijing Kuainiu; launched 2021) closed a multi-¥10M Pre-A led by Fosun RZ Capital, with Chuxin and Daguan following — 2nd round (angel Feb’22) — for product, GTM, and CB talent. CEP stack: CDP, shopping-guide bots, marketing automation across Shopify/Shoplazza/Shopline/WooCommerce + email/FB/IG/WhatsApp — shift sellers from shop ops to user ops.

— END —
